attempt_1_single_whole_interval_delta.description: One TCP delta per 100ms transition, one IK solve + one linear joint-space ramp across the full interval.
attempt_1_single_whole_interval_delta.diagnosis: First large single-transition delta (PREGRASP jump from reset pose, magnitude 5.85cm) causes 18.6mm error at that boundary; decoder forces its own commanded reference to fully reach the target within one 100ms interval, giving less settle time than the true multi-transition-held-target trial had at the same wall-clock point.

attempt_2_ramp_shape_sweep.description: Swept ramp speed from an immediate step (K=1 physics step to reach target) to the full 50-step ramp (K=50), same single whole-interval delta representation.
attempt_2_ramp_shape_sweep.diagnosis: No single ramp speed worked for every large single-transition delta: faster ramps reduced PREGRASP-transition error but increased a later, larger RETREAT-phase delta error (both measured directly). This is a genuine information gap (a 100ms-wide delta cannot describe a trajectory containing a large sub-100ms-scale reference jump), not a tuning problem -- moved to Attempt 3 per the authorized attempt hierarchy.

attempt_3_chunked_sub_actions_SHIPPED.description: Fixed-size sub-action chunk: H sub-deltas per 10Hz transition, each decoded with its own one-IK-solve-plus-one-linear-ramp over SUBSTEPS_PER_TRANSITION/H physics steps.
attempt_3_chunked_sub_actions_SHIPPED.rationale_for_h5_over_h10: H=10 measured marginally better (7.36mm vs 8.09mm) but doubles the action-field size for a target already met with margin by H=5; H=2 (43.1mm) still failed, confirming chunk granularity -- not just chunk presence -- matters.

exact_execution_replay.note: Unchanged from Phase 5C -- literal applied_ctrl replay, no IK re-solve.

accumulated_delta_drift.interpretation: monotonic-nondecreasing running-max is consistent with (but does not prove) unbounded accumulation; a profile that rises then falls indicates bounded, self-correcting error instead

policy_action_replay.state_machine_note: This replay does not reimplement the state machine's SETTLE/VERIFY gating (same disclosed limitation as Phase 5C) -- 'state-machine phase agreement' is reported via the recorded state_machine_phase metadata field (ground truth from the original collection) aligned to each transition index, not independently re-derived. Physical success/placement outcome is judged via final cube position agreement (target_placement_within_margin) rather than an independently re-run success-detector boolean.
policy_action_replay.note: Decodes ONLY policy/actions/{tcp_delta_position,tcp_delta_orientation,gripper_command} through a chunked ramp decoder (H sub-actions per 10Hz transition) that composes each sub-delta onto an internally-tracked commanded reference (never re-read from measured state mid-episode) -- the direct fix for Phase 5C's repeated-static-phase-goal bug, and for Phase 5D attempts 1-2's single-whole-interval-delta shortfall (see reports/phase5d-policy-action-redesign.md).
